author: cnash03
text:
Phase 3 is built on the new `phase-3-chat-ui` branch, which stacks on the still-open Phase 2 PR. Build and all 117 tests pass. Nothing is committed yet. Per your answers, I'll commit, open the PR and run `/ai-report` once you've checked the demo, and the PR will note the extra plain-language citation as model variance to recheck in Phase 7.

**What's built**
- **Ask page:** shows the conversation title and has the plain-language toggle (remembered between launches), a tax-year picker that defaults to 2025, and a New chat button.
  - Your questions show on the right. Each answer shows the "Searched 8 passages, kept the 4 most relevant" line and numbered chips like `1 · Pub 970 · Ch. 1 · p. 5 · TY 2025`.
  - Each answer also has the follow-up chips (including "Quiz me on <topic>") and the disclaimer.
  - There are loading, error-with-retry and refusal states.
- **Source passage panel:** clicking a chip shows the IRS passage with the quoted sentence highlighted, and a button that opens the PDF at that page.
- **Glossary:** `data/glossary.json` has 40 terms. Each definition is based on a real TY2025 chunk, and I checked every chunk ID exists in Qdrant. All are marked `reviewed: false` because the plan needs a person to check them. In plain-language mode, the first use of each term in an answer gets a hover definition.
- **Tests:** 18 new ones covering term matching, chip labels, highlight splitting and the glossary file.

**Checked against the live API**
- **Demo question:** it answers with 6 citations, and every one has a highlighted sentence. Both pages I spot-checked in the PDFs (Pub 970 p. 5 and Pub 519 p. 25) contain their highlighted sentences, so the PDF button lands on the right page.
- **Plain-language mode:** with the toggle on, question 1 cited exactly the same chunks. Question 2 cited one extra valid passage from the same 4 retrieved. Question 3 ("Can my parents still claim me as a dependent…") was refused in both modes because the retrieved passages didn't cover it. That's a retrieval problem for the Phase 7 eval, so I replaced it in the welcome-screen examples.

**Decisions to note in the PR**
- **Hover definitions** only appear in plain-language mode, since that's the section of the plan that describes them.
- **The tax-year picker** sits in the Ask page header, and each feature remembers its own year (chat 2025, calculator 2026).
- **"Quiz me"** sends the chat's cited chunk IDs to the quizzes page, which just acknowledges them until Phase 6.
- **Local dev calls go to `claude-sonnet-5-5`**, not Opus. That's already set in `appsettings.Development.json` and documented in SETUP.md.
- **Your Xcode (27.2) is newer than the MAUI workload expects (27.1).** The app only builds with `-p:ValidateXcodeVersion=false`. I added that tip to the README.

**Your demo check (the API is still running on :5080)**

author: cnash03
text:
Phase 3 is committed and the PR is open: https://github.com/cnash03/Taxwise/pull/5. It targets `phase-2-query-api` because the Phase 2 PR (#4) isn't merged yet; merge #4 first and GitHub will retarget #5 to `main`.

The PR description covers the acceptance results, including the extra citation in plain-language mode (noted as model variance to recheck in Phase 7) and the dependent question that gets refused. It also has a checkbox for reviewing the 40 glossary definitions.

**`/ai-report` added no entries.** This session (`e205fac5`) is the only unlogged one, and the skill skips the session it runs in. The other 9 sessions are already in `docs/prompt-log.md` with no placeholders left, so `AI_USAGE.md` didn't change. Run `/ai-report` in your next session to document Phase 3. The decisions it should pick up from this session:
- You checked the running app yourself before the PR, because I couldn't screenshot or click it from here.
- You accepted the extra plain-language citation as model variance instead of changing the prompt.
- I replaced the welcome example that gets refused.
- The 40 glossary definitions are each tied to a real chunk and still need human review.
- The Xcode 27.2 workaround is documented in the README.

**`DECISIONS.md` doesn't exist yet**, and P4 requires it. Items worth recording from this phase:
- Glossary hover definitions are written by people, never generated, and only show in plain-language mode.
- Each feature remembers its own tax year.
- Chat history survives switching pages, but a request in progress is cancelled when you leave the page.

The only uncommitted change is this session's AI log, which keeps growing until the session ends. The API is still running on :5080 in the background.
